title: Custom Football Over American Flag Background Comforter
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate sports haven with the football comforter set by Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this lightweight and soft bedding set features a stunning retro football flag design that adds a vibrant athletic touch to any bedroom, guestroom, or kids' room.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features custom text inputs allowing you to personalize the bedding with your choice of name and number.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Versatile Use: Designed for football lovers, making it an excellent sports-themed gift for birthdays, holidays, and special celebrations.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in standard US bedding sizes including Twin, Full, Queen, and King.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; quick-drying microfiber fabric gets fluffier with air drying without heat.
  • Included Components: Includes 1 duvet cover or comforter with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Retro Football Flag
Style Contemporary
Theme Football
Pattern American Flag
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization 2 text inputs
